body:
When continuous hidden-state observation and physical reversal assumptions are treated as free inputs, a mathematical dissipation bound can be mistaken for a physical capability. This source-preserving FQ intake adds N822: a three-binary-snapshot certificate with matched independent clocks, a killed-path-affinity proof, and exact clock/readout countermodels. It also preserves the parity lift with identical observed law and the failed chemistry, battery and repair transfers.

The source remains `source_derived_unreviewed`; novelty, physical validation and full-cost superiority are unknown. The analytic ring floor exceeds 0.4 in model-time units, while the explicit finite short-gap fixture exposes a sufficient iid budget near 7.4e14 triplets. The separate comparator addendum distinguishes the rigorous occupancy-TUR floor (361/945) from the stronger but uncertified published numerical waiting-time estimate. Mission status is NOT_ACHIEVED.

Validation: 86 intake files pinned; original 82-file snapshot unchanged; nine selected calculations/public-data audits replayed successfully with two initial missing-library failures retained; exact small-gap check, generated access views and the new checkpoint pass their scoped checks. Repository-wide checkpoint validation still fails on three inherited unsupported-schema records. A full-patch whitespace check reports three preserved Markdown/EOF formatting findings; VALIDATION_CORRECTION_v0001.json records the coverage correction. No historical scientific source or checkpoint was rewritten.

Review entry points: updates/FQ/SYNTHESIS.md, package/operational_closure_v1/root/THREE_SNAPSHOT_OPERATION.md, COMPARATOR_ADDENDUM_v0001.md, and VALIDATION_RECEIPT.json. No physical experiment or breakthrough is claimed.
